entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: A force of detectives and investigators on Ravnica founded and led by the archon Ezrim, set up to investigate crimes without guild bias.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: An archon who broke off from the Azorius to found a truth cult and later transformed it into the R.A.M.I., which he leads.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: A Ravnican guild from which Ezrim broke off, and in whose custody the Agency's proven or suspected criminals are remanded.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that used to be responsible for restoring peace and which considers the Agency amateurs.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: An acclaimed detective and Azorius associate recruited by Ezrim into the Agency.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane of ten guilds where the Agency operates.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in 4562 AR after which the Agency was founded and the guilds were left recovering.

entities.name: Tenth District Plaza
entities.description: Historically neutral guild territory on Ravnica where the R.A.M.I.'s headquarters hovers.

entities.name: R.A.M.I. Headquarters
entities.description: A grand hovering edifice resembling a floating all-seeing eye, with a central atrium, offices, laboratories, archives and evidence lockers.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose former members are among the Agency's necrotopsists.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose former members are among the Agency's necrotopsists.

events.summary: Centuries before the Phyrexian Invasion, Ezrim breaks off from the Azorius and founds a truth cult to aid people and investigate mysteries.
events.quote: Centuries before the Phyrexian Invasion, the archon Ezrim broke off from the Azorius and founded a truth cult to aid people and investigate mysteries.

events.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion in 4562 AR increases demand for the cult's services and many guild members defect to it.
events.quote: many guild members defected from their original guilds to the cult in the aftermath

events.summary: Ezrim transforms his cult into the Agency, recruiting Azorius associates including Alquist Proft and members of all ten guilds.
events.quote: Ezrim transformed his cult into the Agency, recruiting many Azorius associates, including the acclaimed detective Alquist Proft , and members of all ten guilds.

events.summary: After the invasion the Agency grows to the size of the ten guilds and becomes pivotal in restoring peace on the plane.
events.quote: The Agency was pivotal in restoring the peace on the plane
